mapper.select: /*selectCalendarList CALENDAR LIST*/ SELECT CALENDAR_DIV ,TITLE ,CONTENT ,DESK_DIV ,TO_DATE(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS START_TIME ,TO_DATE(END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_TIME ,ALLDAY_DIV AS ALLDAY ,BG_COLOR AS BACKGROUNDCOLOR ,BORDER_COLOR AS BORDERCOLOR ,STATUS_CD ,CHECK_DATE ,CHECK_YN ,MODIFY_USER ,MODIFY_DATE ,CREATE_USER AS EVENT_USER ,CREATE_DATE FROM TB_C_CALENDAR WHERE SUBSTR(START_TIME,0,10) BETWEEN #{in_startDate} AND #{in_endDate} AND DESK_DIV IS NULL OR DESK_DIV IN (#{in_userDesk}) OR CREATE_USER =#{in_userId}
